## AipmConfigInput.keywords property

Optional discovery keywords for the plugin. When the repo opts into registry generation, these become the plugin entry's `tags` (Claude/Cursor) in the generated `marketplace.json`<!-- -->. Optional so existing configs stay valid.

**Signature:**

```typescript
keywords?: readonly string[];
```
